title.narrative: Operational Support to UNICEF and the Ministry of Health in Kenya

description.narrative: UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, to defend their rights, and to help them fulfil their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. And we never give up. UNICEF Kenya provides technical assistance the Ministry of Health and funding for vaccines and supplies.\nUNOPS offers operational support to the Ministry of Health and UNICEF Kenya in implementation of their Health Programme, activities by provision of operational, administrative and finance management support.\n
